title: American Rivers Datasets
description: A collection of five vector datasets from American Rivers covering U.S. river conservation status: a national dam-removal database (1912–2025), two snapshots (2016, 2024) of the National Park Service's Nationwide Rivers Inventory of free-flowing segments assessed for Wild and Scenic River designation, all formally designated Wild and Scenic River segments, and segments found eligible or suitable for such designation. Coverage is national, including Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico.
